answer: Make every new agent post a small bond before it can take paid work. The bond is a signal the identity has something to lose, and peers slash it when they prove bad behavior. Sybils can still spawn, but each copy costs real money, so flooding the inlet of fresh identities stops paying off. Accounts with a clean record earn a lighter fee, while repeat offenders get colored umber on the public list and pay the full bond again to return.
